---
title: "Topic: Research and Development"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Drawn from the CIS and aligned with the OECD Frascati Manual definitions.*

## 12.1 Did your company carry out research and experimental development (R&D) activities during the last financial year?

- Yes, continuously (R&D is an ongoing activity)
- Yes, occasionally (R&D projects are undertaken from time to time)
- No

*Source: CIS / Frascati Manual. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

## 12.2 What was your company's total R&D expenditure in the last financial year?

*(Open numeric field, in €)*

*Source: CIS / Frascati Manual. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

## 12.3 What share of your company's total turnover was spent on R&D in the last financial year?

- None
- Less than 1%
- 1–2%
- 3–5%
- More than 5%

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

## 12.4 How many full-time equivalent (FTE) staff were engaged in R&D activities in your company in the last financial year?

*(Open numeric field)*

*Source: CIS / Frascati Manual. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

## 12.5 What type of R&D does your company mainly carry out?

- Basic research (expanding general scientific knowledge)
- Applied research (aimed at a specific practical goal)
- Experimental development (developing or improving products and processes)
- A mix of the above

*Source: Frascati Manual. Use at: Baseline.*

## 12.6 Where does your company conduct its R&D?

*(Select all that apply)*

- Entirely in-house
- Partly in-house, partly contracted out
- Mainly contracted out to external partners
- In collaboration with universities or research institutes
- In collaboration with other firms

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

## 12.7 Did your company receive any public funding for R&D activities in the last three years?

*(Select all that apply)*

- Local or regional government grant
- National government grant
- EU funding (e.g. Horizon Europe, ERDF, ESF+)
- R&D tax credit or tax incentive
- Subsidised loan for R&D
- None

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline.*

## 12.8 What were the main outputs of your company's R&D activities in the last three years?

*(Select all that apply)*

- New or improved products brought to market
- New or improved production processes
- New patents or utility models filed
- Scientific publications or conference papers
- Spin-off companies created
- None yet – R&D is at an early stage

*Source: CIS / Frascati Manual. Use at: Endline.*
